aaa_enabled.summary: Configure external RADIUS/LDAP authentication for centralized administrator access.
cli: CONFIG AUTH RADIUS ADD host=<RADIUS-SERVER-IP> secret=<SHARED-SECRET>
aaa_enabled.notes: Stormshield SNS supports external authentication via RADIUS, LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, and internal directory. Configure centralized external authentication. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG AUTH).

secure_vty_transport.summary: Ensure SSH console access is enabled and unencrypted HTTP is disabled.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Stormshield SNS does not support telnet daemon. Remote administrative access is strictly provided via SSH and HTTPS. Ref: Stormshield Technical Note - Hardening SNS Firewalls.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Set administrator console and WebAdmin idle session timeout to 10 minutes (600 seconds) or less.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Configure administrator idle session timeout to terminate unattended sessions automatically within 600 seconds. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG CONSOLE / CONFIG WEBADMIN).

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Enforce strong password policy and ensure credentials are cryptographically protected at rest.
cli: CONFIG PASSWDPOLICY SET minLength=12 minComplexity=1 maxAge=90
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Stormshield SNS stores administrative credentials cryptographically hashed by default. Enable strict password policy to enforce complexity and length. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG PASSWDPOLICY).

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Change or remove well-known default SNMP community strings ('public' or 'private').
cli: CONFIG SNMP COMMUNITY ADD name=<CUSTOM_COMMUNITY_STRING> access=ro
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Default SNMP communities expose internal device metrics. Remove public/private and configure unique custom communities or SNMPv3. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG SNMP).

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable cleartext HTTP web administration to enforce HTTPS-only access.
http_server_disabled.notes: Stormshield WebAdmin must enforce TLS encryption. Disabling HTTP prevents interception of credentials and session tokens. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG WEBADMIN).

ssh_version_2.summary: Ensure SSH console service is active (Stormshield SNS enforces SSHv2).
ssh_version_2.notes: Stormshield SNS SSH daemon exclusively supports SSH protocol version 2; SSHv1 is permanently disabled in the underlying FreeBSD OpenSSH implementation. Ref: Stormshield Technical Note - Hardening SNS Firewalls.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure remote syslog logging server and enable local logging buffer.
cli: CONFIG LOG SERVER ADD host=<SYSLOG-SERVER-IP> port=514 type=syslog state=1
logging_enabled.notes: Enable remote syslog forwarding and local log buffering to ensure comprehensive audit logs for security analysis. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG LOG).

management_acl.summary: Restrict WebAdmin and SSH console access to designated management subnets.
management_acl.notes: Limit administrative access by source IP/subnet to prevent unauthorized management attempts from untrusted segments. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG WEBADMIN ACCESS / CONFIG CONSOLE ACCESS).

login_banner.summary: Configure pre-login and post-login warning banners.
cli: CONFIG BANNER state=1 prelogin="Authorized access only. All activities are monitored and logged."
login_banner.notes: Display a formal legal notification warning unauthorized users before login. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG BANNER).

password_min_length.summary: Configure minimum password length requirement of at least 8 characters (recommended: 12+).
password_min_length.notes: Configure password policy to reject passwords shorter than the specified length. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG PASSWDPOLICY).

ntp_configured.summary: Configure redundant NTP time servers for accurate log timestamping.
ntp_configured.notes: Synchronize system time with trusted network time servers to ensure log timestamps are valid evidence. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG NTP).

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Ensure all configured SNMP communities are restricted to read-only access.
cli: CONFIG SNMP COMMUNITY SET name=<COMMUNITY-NAME> access=ro
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Read-write SNMP communities allow remote reconfiguration of device parameters. Ensure access=ro is enforced. Ref: Stormshield SNS CLI / Serverd Commands Reference Guide (CONFIG SNMP COMMUNITY).
